title: Between Scylla and Charybdis (on the sea kit)
part: The sea kit in the strait
hypothesis: The strait reads as two dangers if Charybdis is a brick whirlpool that turns, apart from Scylla's cliff, both are shown together, and the six are taken one by one rather than in one blur, with no bodies inside each other.
variable: look.sea on every key (the whirl, the rowing sweep and wake, benches, offstage windows after each seizure, camera paths for the establishing wide, the galley under the cliff and the abductions); the rowers re-blocked onto thwarts facing the bow; Odysseus kept forward; STRIKE delays and the lift's spread (creatures.js; the player re-patched with tools/perform's patch_motion.py --take); the marks re-probed; the sheet recompiled and the plan re-solved (21 of 21 legal).

metrics_before.clip_audit: the seized sailors packed into each other at 44.0-53.7 s (odyssey/metis/clip/AUDIT.md)

metrics_after.clip: CLIP OD-B12-S04 visible 0.0 s in 0 intervals (gate 0.25 passed)

checks.test: both dangers established: the whirlpool and Scylla's cliff, separate, in one frame
checks.note: a high wide on the kit's camera path (0-5 s): Charybdis as seven stepped brick rings turning west of the ship (look.sea whirl at (-112, -37), r 6 studs, the old whirlpool piece hidden), Scylla's cliff east, the ship between them, the spray column over the whirlpool

checks.test: the galley kept near one danger while the other stays visible
checks.note: a path from the cliff side (18-23.5 s) has the galley under Scylla's rock with Charybdis beyond; the abduction wide (35.5-40.9 s) looks from the whirlpool's side at the ship and the cliff, but the rings are behind the lens there; the ship itself does not move toward the cliff (its rig has no translation)

the six heads strike one after another, 0.75 s apart from 36.3 to 40.0 s, nearest the cave first so no neck reaches across a seated man (STRIKE delays, a new parameter of the creature intent and creatures.js); each man is lifted from his thwart and carried out of sight 1.2 s after (look.sea offstage)

checks.test: no one runs through anything; the audit's packed sailors (44.0-53.7 s) gone
checks.note: tools/metis/clip.js --gate 0.25 on the take: 0 visible intervals. The audit and the first checks found the six seized men packed into each other in the jaws at the cave mouth (9-10 s visible), the seated rowers' legs in the deck, Odysseus's arms through the rowers on his walks. The rowers now sit on thwarts in two columns with an aisle, facing Odysseus at the bow, who no longer walks the length of the ship; the marks were probed afresh (odyssey/choreo/marks) so the strike aims where the men now sit

result: Published as take 2. Charybdis turns west of the ship, Scylla's cliff stands east, the six are taken one at a time and the gate passes. Loose: the taken men vanish 1.2 s after they are lifted (into the cave), so the last beat ('watching their companions die above them') shows Scylla's necks and an empty cliff in close shots, not the men; the whirlpool is behind the lens in the abduction wide; the sheet recompiled on the current engine.
